name: write_lock_reentrant_20261103
comment: ANCHOR: WRITE_LOCK_REENTRANT_20261103 — the shared holdings.json write lock is re-entrant on one thread via a thread-local depth counter (one fd, one kernel lock at the outermost block) while other processes and other threads are still excluded for the whole read-modify-write window. Renamed from a holdings*-prefixed path: the PII guard blocks any **/holdings*.json and must not be silenced.
